name: source-first-clone
description: Source-first Skill and MCP workflow for URL-based website cloning, capture, rebuild, and fidelity verification.

interface.shortDescription: Capture URL evidence, rebuild blocked pages, and verify clone fidelity
interface.longDescription: A Skill and MCP workflow for source-first website cloning. It inspects URLs, discovers embed and preview candidates, classifies when exact reuse is possible, captures runtime evidence with Playwright-style options, and only falls back to bounded reconstruction after source-first paths are exhausted.
defaultPrompt: Use the original embed or preview URL before recreating this reference.
If the original page itself is frameable, use direct iframe reuse instead of rebuilding it.
Inspect this link and tell me whether it should be embedded, sourced, or rebuilt.
Run the full clone_reference_url workflow for this link, attach session-aware capture if needed, and plan the exact clone path for this page.
